inputs.instruct: A mature British female voice with a sharp, posh Received Pronunciation accent. The tone is sophisticated, commanding, and slightly husky with a teasing, playful undertone. She speaks with deliberate, calm confidence and crisp articulation. The voice should sound elegant yet dangerous, like a theatrical high-society witch.
inputs.asr_translate_instruction_override: Translate the speech from {source_language} into {target_language} text. Return only the translated text.

inputs.reference_text: Welcome adventurer, and be my guest, into our humble tavern. Come have a seat, and a drink, before some chit chat !
inputs.voice_instruction: Male voice, mid-50s, deep bass-baritone register with a gravelly, weathered texture, native French speaker. Extremely slow and deliberate pace, heavy deliberate pauses between phrases, each sentence ending on a falling, resonant note that lingers before cutting off. Absolute grave authority and total sincerity, entirely without warmth, entirely without amusement — the voice of someone who has never once smiled while speaking.

inputs.text: Sur cette crête, le vent ne s'arrête jamais. Les bannières y pourrissent avant qu'aucun héros ne les rejoigne. On raconte que même les golems y dorment mal, la nuit, quand la brume descend sur la pierre.
